name: DBMS
series_name: DSSSB TGT CS — DBMS Complete (Notes + 200 Most Expected)
series_description: DBMS from basics to exam level: previous-year questions, chapter-wise practice and the 200 most expected questions with solutions. Notes are in Courses → DSSSB TGT Computer Science → DBMS.
tagline: ER model · keys · relational model & algebra · normalisation 1NF–BCNF · SQL · transactions · indexing
intro: In the 4 official DSSSB TGT Computer Science papers of 2023–24 there were {n} DBMS questions, about 6 per paper. Most are one-line definitions in textbook wording (Korth, Navathe), SQL syntax and built-in function questions, and a few short numericals (attribute closure, conflict serializability). Learn the exact definitions, the SQL functions table and the three numerical methods in these notes.
